mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMTNLEADERSCHDUL ( SCHDUL_ID, SCHDUL_SE, SCHDUL_NM, SCHDUL_CN, SCHDUL_PLACE, LEADER_ID, REPTIT_SE_CODE, SCHDUL_BGNDE, SCHDUL_ENDDE, SCHDUL_CHARGER_ID, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, CAL_ID, RESERVED_ROOM, SHARE_ID ) VALUES ( #{schdulId}, #{schdulSe}, #{schdulNm}, #{schdulCn}, #{schdulPlace}, #{leaderId}, #{reptitSeCode}, #{schdulBgnde}, #{schdulEndde}, #{schdulChargerId}, #{frstRegisterId}, #{lastUpdusrId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{calId}, #{reservedRoom}, #{shareId} )
mapper.select: SELECT TRIM(s.SCHDUL_ID) AS "schdul_id", TRIM(s.SCHDUL_NM) AS "title", CASE WHEN s.SCHDUL_BGNDE IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(s.SCHDUL_BGNDE)) = 14 THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(TRIM(s.SCHDUL_BGNDE), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') ELSE NULL END AS "start_dt", CASE WHEN s.SCHDUL_ENDDE IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(s.SCHDUL_ENDDE)) = 14 THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(TRIM(s.SCHDUL_ENDDE), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') ELSE NULL END AS "end_dt", TRIM(s.SCHDUL_PLACE) AS "schdul_place", TRIM(s.SCHDUL_CN) AS "schdul_cn", TRIM(s.CAL_ID) AS "calId", TRIM(s.SHARE_ID) AS "shareId", NVL(TRIM(c.COLOR), TRIM(cs.SH_COLOR)) AS "color" FROM COMTNLEADERSCHDUL s LEFT JOIN CALENDAR c ON TRIM(s.CAL_ID) = TRIM(c.CAL_ID) LEFT JOIN CALSHARE cs ON TRIM(s.SHARE_ID) = TRIM(cs.SHARE_ID) WHERE TRIM(s.CAL_ID) IN ( SELECT TRIM(cal_id) FROM CALENDAR WHERE TRIM(owner_id) = #{ownerId} ) OR TRIM(s.SHARE_ID) IN ( SELECT TRIM(share_id) FROM CALSHARE WHERE TRIM(mber_id) IN (#{ownerId}, #{mberId}) OR TRIM(owner_id) IN (#{ownerId}, #{mberId}) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CALENDAR ( CAL_ID, CAL_NAME, COLOR, NOTE, ADD_DE, POST_DE, OWNER_ID ) VALUES ( #{calId}, #{calName}, #{color}, 'test', SYSDATE, SYSDATE, #{ownerId} )
mapper.select: SELECT TRIM(cal_id) AS cal_id, TRIM(cal_name) AS cal_name, TRIM(color) AS color, TRIM(owner_id) AS owner_id FROM CALENDAR WHERE TRIM(owner_id) = #{ownerId} ORDER BY cal_name

SELECT m.MTGRUM_ID, m.MTGRUM_NM FROM COMTNMTGPLACEMANAGE m WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM COMTNLEADERSCHDUL s WHERE s.RESERVED_ROOM = m.MTGRUM_ID AND s.SCHDUL_BGNDE <= #{reserveDateTime} AND s.SCHDUL_ENDDE > #{reserveDateTime} ) ORDER BY m.MTGRUM_NM
SELECT TRIM(MTGRUM_ID) AS MTGRUM_ID, TRIM(MTGRUM_NM) AS MTGRUM_NM FROM COMTNMTGPLACEMANAGE ORDER BY MTGRUM_NM
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CALSHARE ( SHARE_ID, AUTHORITY, MBER_ID, SH_DE, SHERE_NM, SH_COLOR, OWNER_ID ) VALUES ( #{shareId}, #{authority}, #{mberId}, SYSDATE, #{shereNm}, #{shColor}, #{ownerId} )
mapper.select: SELECT MIN(TRIM(cs.SHARE_ID)) AS shareId, MIN(TRIM(cs.AUTHORITY)) AS authority, MIN(TRIM(cs.MBER_ID)) AS mberId, MIN(cs.SH_DE) AS shDe, TRIM(cs.SH_COLOR) AS shColor, TRIM(cs.SHERE_NM) AS shereNm, MIN(TRIM(cs.OWNER_ID)) AS ownerId FROM CALSHARE cs WHERE TRIM(cs.MBER_ID) = #{loginId} OR TRIM(cs.OWNER_ID) = #{loginId} GROUP BY TRIM(cs.SHERE_NM), TRIM(cs.SH_COLOR)
mapper.update: UPDATE COMTNLEADERSCHDUL SET SCHDUL_NM = #{schdulNm}, SCHDUL_CN = #{schdulCn}, SCHDUL_PLACE = #{schdulPlace}, SCHDUL_BGNDE = #{schdulBgnde}, SCHDUL_ENDDE = #{schdulEndde}, RESERVED_ROOM = #{reservedRoom}, LAST_UPDUSR_ID = #{lastUpdusrId}, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE TRIM(SCHDUL_ID) = TRIM(#{schdulId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM COMTNLEADERSCHDUL WHERE TRIM(SCHDUL_ID) = TRIM(#{schdulId})
mapper.select: SELECT TRIM(s.SCHDUL_ID) AS schdulId, TRIM(s.SCHDUL_NM) AS schdulNm, TRIM(s.SCHDUL_CN) AS schdulCn, TRIM(s.SCHDUL_PLACE) AS schdulPlace, TRIM(s.SCHDUL_BGNDE) AS schdulBgnde, TRIM(s.SCHDUL_ENDDE) AS schdulEndde, TRIM(s.CAL_ID) AS calId, TRIM(s.RESERVED_ROOM) AS roomId, TRIM(s.SHARE_ID) AS shareId, TRIM(r.MTGRUM_NM) AS roomName FROM COMTNLEADERSCHDUL s LEFT JOIN COMTNMTGPLACEMANAGE r ON s.RESERVED_ROOM = r.MTGRUM_ID WHERE TRIM(s.SCHDUL_ID) = TRIM(#{schdulId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM CALENDAR WHERE TRIM(CAL_ID) = TRIM(#{calId})
DELETE FROM CALSHARE WHERE TRIM(SHARE_ID) = TRIM(#{calId})
